title: AI-Powered Dental CAD Solution for Fully Automated Digital Prosthesis Design
summary: Imagoworks reports that Dentbird generates patient-specific dental designs in minutes, automating labor-intensive CAD work during real-world pilots.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Dentbird uses deep learning and 3D dental data to detect margins and generate prosthesis designs. Imagoworks describes real-world pilots and automated design in minutes, claiming lower technician workload and shorter treatment workflows. The source does not provide a standardized before-and-after timing comparison or a patient health outcome.
purpose: Automate dental prosthesis design and reduce manual CAD work.

ratings.reason: The maker reports automated prosthesis designs in minutes and reduced manual workload during pilots; this is a claimed workflow convenience, without a standardized timing comparison.
Shorter treatment and improved oral health are claimed generally without an measured patient outcome.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 6: AI-Powered Dental CAD Solution for Fully Automated Digital Prosthesis Design

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: Dentbird automates dental prosthesis design

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
